name: elyagents
description: AI trading agents on Robinhood Chain: web (Next.js) + server (Node.js), with token launches on pons.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @elyagents/server" "npm run dev -w @elyagents/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @elyagents/server && npm run build -w @elyagents/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run start -w @elyagents/server" "npm run start -w @elyagents/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @elyagents/shared && npm run typecheck -w @elyagents/server && npm run typecheck -w @elyagents/web
